### servel abort

Cancel an in-progress deployment.

```bash
servel abort [name] [flags]
```

**Aliases:** abort, cancel

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--all` | abort all in-progress deployments |
| `--force` / `-f` | skip confirmation prompt |
| `--host` `string` | host scope for --slot when the queue is cluster-aware |
| `--queue-entry` `string` | abort by raw build-queue entry ID |
| `--slot` `int` | abort by build-queue slot index (use with --host for cluster-aware queues) (default -1) |

### servel add

Add infrastructure component from catalog or custom template.

```bash
servel add [type] [name] [flags]
```

**Aliases:** add, create, new

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--advanced` | Show advanced configuration options |
| `--alias` `string` | Pin to node by alias (stable, requires prior alias setup via 'servel node alias') |
| `--backup-schedule` `string` | Cron schedule for default daily backup (backup-able types only) (default "0 3 * * *") |
| `--category` / `-c` `string` | Filter by category when listing |
| `--cpu` `float` | CPU cores (e.g., 0.5, 2) |
| `--domain` `string` | Custom domain (e.g., db.example.com). Auto-generated if not specified. |
| `--dry-run` | Preview deployment without creating resources |
| `--env` `string` | Environment (production, staging, dev) (default "production") |
| `--force` / `-f` | Force creation even if exists |
| `--geo` | Enable geo-distributed deployment (requires --ha, nodes must have region= labels) |
| `--ha` | Deploy high-availability cluster (requires 3+ nodes, available for: postgres, redis, mysql, mongodb) |
| `--label` `strings` | Pin to nodes matching label (can be specified multiple times: --label storage=ssd --label memory=high) |
| `--list` / `-l` | List available infrastructure templates |
| `--memory` `string` | Memory limit (e.g., 512MB, 4GB) |
| `--name` `string` | Name for this infrastructure component |
| `--no-backup-schedule` | Skip default backup schedule for backup-able infra types |
| `--node` `string` | Pin to node by hostname (may break if hostname changes) |
| `--node-id` `string` | Pin to node by Docker node ID (most stable) |
| `--prefix` `string` | Prefix for infrastructure names when adding multiple types (e.g., --prefix myproject creates myproject-redis, myproject-postgres) |
| `--quiet` / `-q` | Minimal output (only show final result) |
| `--registry` `string` | Registry URL for template fetching (set empty to use local templates) (default "https://hub.servel.dev") |
| `--replicas` `int` | Number of replicas (default 1) |
| `--replicated` | Store volumes on the replicated substrate (LINSTOR/DRBD) — survives node loss |
| `--search` / `-s` `string` | Search infrastructure templates |
| `--storage` `string` | Storage size (e.g., 20GB, 100GB) |
| `--storage-replicas` `int` | Number of synchronous storage replicas (default 2 with tiebreaker, 3 without) |
| `--template` `string` | Path to custom template file (YAML) |
| `--tier` `string` | Deployment tier for HA templates (minimal, standard, full) |
| `--var` `strings` | Template variable (can be specified multiple times: --var Name=value --var Domain=example.com) |
| `--var-file` `string` | Load template variables from file (.env or YAML format) |
| `--verbose` / `-v` | Show full output (Docker pull progress, git operations, etc.) |
| `--version` `string` | Version to use (default "latest") |
| `--without` `strings` | Comma-separated compose services to leave out (only those a template declares optional) |

### servel ai

Start an interactive AI assistant session that understands your server infrastructure.

```bash
servel ai [question] [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--agent` `string` | AI agent backend: claude, codex, opencode (auto-detects if omitted) |
| `--ai-config` `string` | AI config path (default ~/.servel/ai.yaml) |
| `--remote` `string` | target server (overrides default) |

### servel ai install

Persistently register servel's MCP server into a coding agent's config so

```bash
servel ai install <claude|codex|opencode> [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--allow-destructive` | also register destructive tools (rm, rollback, prune) |
| `--binary` `string` | path to the servel binary (default: this executable) |
| `--global` | write the user-wide config instead of project-local |
| `--read-only` | register read tools only (no write/destructive) |
| `--remote` `strings` | remote(s) to wire (default: configured default remote) |

### servel ai uninstall

Remove servel's MCP server from a coding agent

```bash
servel ai uninstall <claude|codex|opencode> [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--global` | write the user-wide config instead of project-local |

### servel alerts



### servel auth

Manage CLI identity and deployment authentication.


### servel auth disable

Disable basic authentication on a live deployment without redeploying.

```bash

```

Enable basic authentication on a live deployment without redeploying.

```bash

```

|---|---|


### servel auth logout



### servel backup

Create a backup archive containing deployments, infrastructure, and optionally volume data.

```bash

```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--deployments` `strings` | Specific deployments to backup (comma-separated, default: all) |
| `--include-data` | Include volume data (increases backup size) |
| `--infrastructure` `strings` | Specific infrastructure to backup (comma-separated, default: all) |
| `--output` / `-o` `string` | Output path for backup archive (default: servel-backup-&#123;timestamp&#125;.tar.gz[.age]) |
| `--passphrase` `string` | Encryption passphrase (will prompt if not provided) |
| `--skip-encryption` | Skip encryption (not recommended) |

### servel deploy

Deploy an application to the server.

```bash
servel deploy [path|alias] [flags]
```

**Aliases:** deploy, push, d, dv

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--abort` | abort mode: Ctrl+C kills deployment (default: detach, deployment continues) |
| `--allow-index` | allow search engine indexing (override smart defaults) |
| `--allow-ip` `strings` | restrict access to IPs/CIDRs (e.g., --allow-ip 10.0.0.0/8) |
| `--auth-password` `string` | basic auth password (override servel.yaml) |
| `--auth-username` `string` | basic auth username (override servel.yaml) |
| `--author` `string` | override deployment author (default: git author or current user) |
| `--auto-cache` | auto-use previous version as build cache (default: true) (default true) |
| `--build-cmd` `string` | override build command (e.g., 'pnpm build:production') |
| `--build-cpus` `float` | build CPU limit (e.g., 2.0) - default: auto-calculated |
| `--build-env` `stringArray` | build-time env var KEY=VALUE, repeatable (e.g. --build-env SITE_ORIGIN=https://example.com); visible to the build itself, baked into the image — not for secrets |
| `--build-memory` `string` | build memory limit (e.g., '4g', '2048m') - default: auto-calculated |
| `--build-on` `string` | build on specific node (hostname or node ID prefix) - auto-selects node with most RAM if not specified |
| `--build-type` `string` | override build type detection (dockerfile, compose, nixpacks) |
| `--cache-fallback` `string` | fallback deployment name for cache lookup (auto-set for preview) |
| `--cache-from` `string` | use image as build cache (e.g., myapp:latest) |
| `--compress` | enable response compression (gzip) |
| `--constraint` `strings` | placement constraint (e.g., --constraint 'node.role==manager') |
| `--convergence-timeout` `string` | time to wait for service convergence (default: 5m) (default "5m") |
| `--cpu` `float` | runtime CPU limit (e.g., 0.5, 1.0) - 0 or negative to remove limit |
| `--dashboard` | show real-time TUI dashboard during deployment |
| `--detach` | fire-and-forget: return to shell after upload, deployment continues on server |
| `--dockerfile` `string` | path to Dockerfile relative to project root (e.g. 'services/issuer/Dockerfile'); skips the stage-at-root workaround |
| `--domain` / `-d` `string` | domain for routing (e.g., app.example.com) |
| `--dry-run` | preview deployment without making changes |
| `--env` / `-e` `string` | environment to deploy to (production, staging, preview) |
| `--explain` | show build type detection AND deploy cache decision (per-input hashes, git relationship, diff vs deployed) |
| `--fast` | optimize for speed: skip convergence, use local images, minimal delay |
| `--force-low-disk` | bypass the ≥95% disk pressure block on the build node |
| `--force-low-ram` | bypass the build-OOM gate when no build node meets the framework RAM minimum (OOM risk; prefer --local-build) |
| `--force-registry` | force registry push even on single-node swarm |
| `--force-server` | suppress server mismatch warnings |
| `--install-cmd` `string` | override install command (e.g., 'pnpm install --frozen-lockfile') |
| `--interactive` / `-i` | force interactive prompts (first deploy prompts by default, repeat deploys skip) |
| `--interactive-env` | interactively configure environment variables before deployment |
| `--internal` | force linked infra to use internal Docker DNS; error if any link is cross-swarm |
| `--keep-previous` | keep current version as a version preview after deploying |
| `--keep-previous-ttl` `string` | TTL for the kept previous version preview (default "24h") |
| `--link-infra` `strings` | link infrastructure services (e.g., --link-infra mydb,redis) |
| `--local-build` | build image locally (more RAM), push to registry, then deploy |
| `--low-memory` | reduce memory usage during builds (limits workers, caps heap size) |
| `--max-body-size` `string` | maximum request body size (e.g., '10MB') |
| `--memory` `string` | runtime memory limit (e.g., '1g', '512m', 'none' to remove limit) |
| `--message` / `-m` `string` | deployment message/comment (e.g., 'Fix auth bug #123') |
| `--migrate-secrets` | auto-detect sensitive env vars and migrate to encrypted secrets |
| `--name` / `-n` `string` | deployment name (default: directory name) |
| `--new` | force new deployment with unique subdomain (e.g., app-a1b2c3) |
| `--no-auth` | disable basic auth (override servel.yaml) |
| `--no-auto-respawn` | disable the single force-respawn that runs when the post-deploy probe fails |
| `--no-cache` | skip cache read AND write (build won't be cached for future use) |
| `--no-cleanup` | skip automatic cleanup of build artifacts (dangling images, stopped containers) |
| `--no-index` | prevent search engine indexing (force noindex header) |
| `--no-registry` | skip registry entirely (no auto-deploy, no push) |
| `--no-smart` | disable smart detection, always do full build |
| `--no-standalone` | skip Next.js standalone auto-injection |
| `--no-sticky` | clear data-node (stateful) and home-node (stateless) bindings; re-place from scratch. WARNING: may cause data loss for stateful apps |
| `--node` `string` | force runtime placement to a specific node hostname (bypasses smart placement) |
| `--port` `string` | override port (e.g., '3000', '8080') |
| `--pr` `int` | pull request number (for preview URL generation) |
| `--prefer-label` `strings` | prefer nodes with label (e.g., --prefer-label storage=ssd) |
| `--preview` | deploy as preview environment with auto-cleanup |
| `--probe-path` `string` | post-deploy probe path on the primary HTTP route (default '/') |
| `--probe-timeout` `duration` | total budget for the post-deploy probe (default 30s) |
| `--public` | force linked infra to use public-domain hostnames (overrides per-link access:internal) |
| `--pull` | always attempt to pull a newer version of base images |
| `--queue-timeout` `string` | max wait for a build slot (e.g. '1h', '2 days', 'none'/'0' for infinite). Empty = server default (10m) |
| `--quiet` / `-q` | minimal output (only show final result) |
| `--rate-limit` `string` | rate limit requests (e.g., '100' for 100/s, or '100/200' for avg/burst) |
| `--rebuild` | force rebuild but still cache the result for future builds |
| `--registry-path` `string` | custom registry image path (e.g., 'myorg/myproject') |
| `--reuse-image` | skip build, reuse previous deployment's image (for env/config changes) |
| `--runtime` `string` | runtime for JS/TS projects: 'node' (default) or 'bun' |
| `--save` | persist deploy flags to servel.yaml |
| `--secure-headers` | enable security headers (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, etc.) |
| `--skip-build` | skip build step, use pre-built output (run 'npm run build' locally first) |
| `--skip-convergence` | skip service convergence verification (faster, less safe) |
| `--skip-migrations` | skip running servel.yaml migrations before this deploy |
| `--skip-probe` | skip the post-deploy URL probe (still marks the deployment running on Swarm convergence) |
| `--skip-queue` | bypass build queue (emergency use only — concurrent builds may cause OOM) |
| `--start-cmd` `string` | override start command (e.g., 'node dist/server.js') |
| `--static-only` | sync public/static files to running container (no rebuild) |
| `--sticky` | enable sticky sessions (session affinity) |
| `--strategy` `string` | node selection strategy: smart, spread, binpack, memory-first, none (default "smart") |
| `--supersede` | cancel any in-progress build for this deployment before starting (saves queue time when re-deploying) |
| `--sync-only` | sync files to mounted volumes without rebuild (requires volumes in servel.yaml) |
| `--tag` `strings` | add project tags (e.g., --tag frontend --tag production) |
| `--timeout` `string` | request timeout (e.g., '60s') |
| `--ttl` `string` | time-to-live for preview deployment (e.g., 1h, 6h, 1d, 7d, 2w) (default "7d") |
| `--verbose` / `-v` | show full build output (Nixpacks, Docker buildkit, etc.) |

### servel dev

Create and manage ephemeral development containers with file sync.

```bash
servel dev [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--auth` | Enable basicauth on public dev URL |

| `--build-method` `string` | Force build method: nixpacks, dockerfile, compose, auto (default: auto) |
| `--cleanup` | Remove server files on exit |

| `--domain` `string` | Custom domain (subdomain or full domain) |
| `--env` / `-e` `string` | Environment name (default "dev") |
| `--exclude` `strings` | Exclude these env keys (blacklist, comma-separated) |
| `--link-env` `string` | Pull plaintext env from a production deployment by name |
| `--link-infra` `strings` | Inject connection env vars from one or more @infra (comma-separated) |
| `--memory` `string` | Sandbox memory limit, e.g. 8GB (default: dev.resources.memory or 6GB) |
| `--name` / `-n` `string` | Custom name for dev session |
| `--new` | Force new session (don't reuse existing) |
| `--no-auth` | Skip auth prompt |
| `--no-claude` | SSH into synced directory without starting Claude |

| `--no-tunnel` | Disable auto-tunnel for internal hostnames (values pass through unchanged with a warning) |
| `--only` `strings` | Only inject these env keys (whitelist, comma-separated) |
| `--port` / `-p` `int` | Override port (auto-detected if 0) |
| `--provider` `string` | Force runtime provider: node, bun, deno, go, python, rust, etc. |
| `--remote` `string` | Server name from config (alias for --server) |
| `--remote-path` `string` | Override remote directory (default: ~/dev/&#123;project&#125;) |
| `--secrets` | Include decrypted secrets when pulling env (requires dev:env:pull scope or owner) |
| `--server` / `-s` `string` | Server name from config (defaults to active server) |
| `--team` | Enable bidirectional sync (team collaboration) |
| `--verbose` / `-v` | Show verbose output (all INFO logs) |

| `--prefix` `string` | Prefix for infrastructure names when adding multiple types (e.g., --prefix myproject creates myproject-redis, myproject-postgres) |
| `--quiet` / `-q` | Minimal output (only show final result) |
| `--registry` `string` | Registry URL for template fetching (set empty to use local templates) (default "https://hub.servel.dev") |
| `--replicas` `int` | Number of replicas (default 1) |
| `--replicated` | Store volumes on the replicated substrate (LINSTOR/DRBD) — survives node loss |
| `--search` / `-s` `string` | Search infrastructure templates |
| `--storage` `string` | Storage size (e.g., 20GB, 100GB) |
| `--storage-replicas` `int` | Number of synchronous storage replicas (default 2 with tiebreaker, 3 without) |
| `--template` `string` | Path to custom template file (YAML) |
| `--tier` `string` | Deployment tier for HA templates (minimal, standard, full) |
| `--var` `strings` | Template variable (can be specified multiple times: --var Name=value --var Domain=example.com) |
| `--var-file` `string` | Load template variables from file (.env or YAML format) |
| `--verbose` / `-v` | Show full output (Docker pull progress, git operations, etc.) |
| `--version` `string` | Version to use (default "latest") |
| `--without` `strings` | Comma-separated compose services to leave out (only those a template declares optional) |

| `--dry-run` | Show detailed step-by-step plan without executing |
| `--fast` | Shortcut for --strategy snapshot (pre-copy live migration) |
| `--from-remote` `string` | Override source remote (default: auto-detect from project's .servel/state.json) |
| `--iterations` `int` | Max pre-copy iterations before cutover (1-5, default 1) |
| `--plan` | Print the migration plan (size, ETA, services) and exit without moving |
| `--pointer-only` | Skip data migration (UNSAFE: only after data was moved manually) |
| `--repo-location` `string` | Repo location for snapshot migration: target-sftp (default, no source storage) \| local (staged) |
| `--strategy` `string` | Migration strategy: auto\|fullcopy\|snapshot\|replicated (default "auto") |
| `--to` `string` | Target node hostname (required) |
| `--to-remote` `string` | Migrate to a different operator-managed remote (cross-remote mode) |
| `--unsafe-leave-links` | Proceed even when source-side deployments link to this infra (links will break) |
| `--yes` / `-y` | Skip confirmation prompts |

| `--skip-docker` | skip Docker installation check |
| `--skip-preflight` | skip network port checks |
| `--skip-servel` | skip servel binary installation |
| `--skip-storage` | skip distributed storage setup (LINSTOR satellite) |
| `--type` `string` | provider instance type (default: provider's zero-config choice) |


|---|---|

| `--yes` | skip confirmation prompt |

### servel upgrade

Upgrade servel to the latest version from servel.dev.

```bash
servel upgrade [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--base-url` `string` | base URL for servel API (for development) (default "https://servel.dev") |
| `--channel` `string` | release channel: alpha or stable (default "stable") |
| `--check` | check for updates without installing |
| `--force` | force upgrade even if already on latest version |
| `--no-twin` | skip twin-serving probation (sentinel auto-revert); do a direct swap |
| `--pin` `string` | persist a pinned version (e.g. v0.4.2) or 'off' to clear; auto-update never goes past pinned version |
| `--rollback` | restore the previously-installed binary (.prev) |
| `--servers` | also upgrade all configured servers |
| `--set-mode` `string` | persist auto-update mode: notify \| apply \| off |
| `--version` `string` | upgrade to specific version (e.g., v1.1.0-alpha.3) |

### servel upgrade-servers

Upgrade all or specific servers to match the client version.

```bash
servel upgrade-servers [flags]
```

| Flag | Description |
|---|---|
| `--dry-run` | show what would be upgraded without making changes |
| `--force` | force upgrade even if versions match |
| `--health-wait` `duration` | max time to wait for a server to return healthy before proceeding to the next (rolling) (default 1m0s) |
| `--ignore-deploy-lock` | proceed even if a deploy is in flight on the target server (dangerous) |
| `--no-rolling` | upgrade every server at once without the per-server health gate (not recommended for production) |
| `--server` `string` | upgrade specific server only |
